body.statement: For a linear Gaussian member of \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PNHZ}}\) with nonsingular measured covariance, the conditional mean has a unique \(P_{X_A}\)-essential derivative, \(J_{A,B}=\operatorname{Cov}(X_B,X_A)\operatorname{Cov}(X_A,X_A)^{-1}\), so every RankPeel pair lies in \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{stab}}(P_X)\) and its law-invariant query rank equals the corresponding cross-covariance rank. The restricted separator upper bounds and private-path lower bounds therefore reduce to Gaussian trek separation and generic noncancellation.
body.justification: The reduction is the required sanity check and locates the nonlinear theorem relative to known linear rank geometry.
body.gap: The linear literature does not supply the nonlinear analytic factorization or this same-class deterministic certificate.
body.consumer: Implementations can validate exact RankPeel transcripts on rational linear Gaussian SEMs before estimating nonlinear Jacobians.
